bullets: Fixed GPT-6 Luna and MiMo 2.6 Pro to no longer require a US location or paid plan, allowing full access to all Freebuff users.
Added a filter that blocks WSL entry, destructive database operations, and container lifecycle shell commands during sponsored runs before they execute.
Added the ability for sponsored tasks to declare and receive specific advertiser credentials inside a locked-down sandbox.
Improved the Linux terminal copy fallback to show a clearer hint recommending wl-clipboard or xclip when no native clipboard tool is available.
Added new explicitly-registered partner ad slots and reorganized ad placement types so partner formats are not treated like sponsor break ads.
Added automatic resumption of a previously held free coding session hour after an update-based restart, if it still belongs to your account.
Fixed Codebuff out-of-credits 402 responses to no longer be misclassified as provider usage errors on the CLI.
Improved the agent runtime to elide binary payloads from compaction summaries, preventing repeated slow summarizations of image-heavy threads.
Added local crash report saving on unexpected exits and automatic quiet crash report submission on the next launch.
Updated the fallback model label displayed after a session ends to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash instead of DeepSeek V4 Flash.
Replaced the /reasoning command with a new /model command that brings inline model selection and session start controls directly into the chat UI.
